prohibitedUses.description: Ranking, scoring, or evaluating an identifiable worker's performance.
Supporting discipline, dismissal, redundancy selection, or adverse employment action.
Identifying or monitoring union membership, representation, organising, or activity.
Monitoring industrial action or preparations for industrial action.
Inferring the sentiment, mood, cohesion, or legitimacy of a workforce, union, or membership.
Making an unreviewed editorial or professional decision with material consequences.
